ABSTRACT
This research paper explores Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev's guiding philosophy, as presented in "Inner
Harmony and Karma: Exploring Sadhguru's Guiding Philosophy." Synthesizing insights from his seminal
works, "Inner Engineering" and "Karma: A Yogi's Guide," the look illuminates the foundational principles
of reaching concord among self and the arena. Emphasizing self-consciousness, mindfulness, and conscious
movements, Sadhguru's teachings offer a complete framework for individuals on a transformative journey.
The philosophy integrates yogic practices, internal engineering techniques, and nuanced knowledge of
karma, presenting practical equipment for holistic well-being. Significantly, Sadhguru's philosophy extends
past private improvement to encourage superb contributions to the bigger cosmic order. The abstract
concludes by suggesting potential avenues for further research, acknowledging the philosophy's common
relevance and its ability to affect character and collective well-being.
Keywords: Sadhguru, Inner Harmony, Karma, Self-attention, Mindfulness, Conscious Actions,
Transformative Journey, Holistic Well-being, Philosophy, Spiritual Guidance, Universal Relevance, Inner
Engineering.
